source: curated (Cycle 24 Phase 8 slice 1) from Ableton Live 12 manual/help references

references.title: Synchronizing with Link, Tempo Follower, and MIDI

plugin_formats.label: Ableton native
plugin_formats.description: Built-in Live device or rack; use device schemas when available.

plugin_formats.label: Max for Live
plugin_formats.description: AMXD-backed Live device; inspect patcher metadata read-only in Phase 8 slice 1.

plugin_formats.label: VST2
plugin_formats.description: Third-party VST2 plug-in; Live exposes configured automatable parameters.

plugin_formats.label: VST3
plugin_formats.description: Third-party VST3 plug-in; expanded sidecar parameter coverage is future work.

plugin_formats.label: Audio Units 2
plugin_formats.description: macOS Audio Unit plug-in format supported by Live.

plugin_formats.label: Audio Units 3
plugin_formats.description: macOS Audio Unit v3 plug-in format supported by recent Live versions.

plugin_formats.label: Unknown
plugin_formats.description: Runtime did not expose enough metadata to classify the device format.

m4l_capabilities.label: Patcher metadata
m4l_capabilities.description: Name, path, device class, frozen state, or similar patcher identity when exposed.

m4l_capabilities.label: Exposed parameters
m4l_capabilities.description: Parameters visible to Live automation and normal device parameter reads.

m4l_capabilities.label: Live API paths
m4l_capabilities.description: Canonical Live API object paths that the runtime can safely report.

m4l_capabilities.label: Dependencies
m4l_capabilities.description: External files or patch dependencies when the runtime exposes them safely.

link_status_fields.label: Available
link_status_fields.description: Whether the current Live runtime exposes Link status to the bridge.

link_status_fields.label: Enabled
link_status_fields.description: Whether Link is enabled in Live when that property is exposed.

link_status_fields.label: Peer count
link_status_fields.description: Number of Link peers reported by Live, if exposed.

link_status_fields.label: Start/Stop Sync
link_status_fields.description: Whether Link start/stop sync is enabled, if exposed.

link_status_fields.label: Link Audio
link_status_fields.description: Whether Link Audio status is exposed by the current Live runtime.

link_status_fields.label: Reason
link_status_fields.description: Human-readable unsupported or unavailable reason from the bridge.
